title: TabPFN beyond Tabular Data: Calibration and Accuracy on Multimodal Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2607.11007v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Few-shot multimodal classification commonly attaches a lightweight head, such as $k$-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, or a linear SVM, to a frozen pretrained encoder. Although computationally efficient, these heads can produce poorly calibrated confidence scores. We ask whether TabPFN can provide reliable confidence estimates on multimodal embeddings without sacrificing predictive accuracy, and under what conditions. We systematically evaluate TabPFN as a zero-gradient head for frozen image, text, and audio encoders. Across 22{,}820 evaluation episodes spanning 14 datasets, 11 encoders, and three modalities, TabPFN achieves the best mean rank among nine classification heads on both negative log-likelihood (NLL) and expected calibration error (ECE). translated_title: 超越表格数据的TabPFN：多模态嵌入上的校准与精度
translated_abstract: 少样本多模态分类通常在冻结的预训练编码器上附加一个轻量级头部，例如k近邻、逻辑回归或线性SVM。尽管这些头部计算效率高，但可能产生校准不佳的置信度分数。我们探究了TabPFN能否在多模态嵌入上提供可靠的置信度估计而不牺牲预测精度，以及在什么条件下能够做到。我们系统地评估了TabPFN作为冻结图像、文本和音频编码器的零梯度分类头的表现。在涵盖14个数据集、11个编码器和三种模态的22,820个评估回合中，TabPFN在九种分类头中于负对数似然（NLL）和期望校准误差（ECE）两项指标上均取得最佳平均排名。在一个代表性设置下，相对于八个基线的平均水平，它将NLL降低了48–62%，ECE降低了2.1–5.3倍，同时保持或超越了它们的平均精度。
tldr: 该研究发现TabPFN可直接用作冻结多模态编码器（图像、文本、音频）的零梯度分类头，在22,820个评估回合中其校准性能（NLL和ECE）在九种分类头中排名最佳，同时保持甚至超越基线精度。
en_tdlr: TabPFN can serve as a zero-gradient classification head on frozen multimodal (image, text, audio) encoder embeddings, achieving the best calibration (NLL and ECE) among nine heads across 22,820 evaluation episodes while matching or exceeding baseline accuracy.
